Talent Acquisition Partner @ Sunday || HR ||
2w •
**We’re Hiring: Senior Data Engineer**
📍 Location: Remote
💼 Experience:5+ years
⏳ Immediate joiners only.
We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Data Engineer to build scalable enterprise data platforms and high-performance data pipelines supporting analytics, AI, and business operations.
**What you’ll do:**
* Design and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines and enterprise data architectures.
* Build high-volume Python ingestion frameworks and REST/GraphQL API integrations.
* Develop batch, near-real-time, and event-driven data solutions.
* Ensure data quality, lineage, observability, performance, and cost optimization.
* Collaborate with AI, architecture, product, and business teams.
**Must-have skills:**
* Strong production-grade Python and advanced API engineering.
* Data architecture, system design, Medallion Architecture, CDC, and enterprise data modeling.
* Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, and Snowflake.
* Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Azure Synapse, and Event Hubs.
* Advanced SQL, data pipeline design, Git, and CI/CD.
**Preferred:** Apache Airflow, dbt, Kafka, Terraform, Azure OpenAI, and AI/ML data pipelines.
Interested? Apply here: https://lnkd.in/dS_j_Dqn or share your profile in DM or on isha.yadav@sundaylabs.io
#Hiring #SeniorDataEngineer #DataEngineering #Python #Databricks #Snowflake #Azure #SQL
Entiovi is hiring Sr Data Engineer on Sunday.
10x.sundaylabs.io
